**Renaming is safe everywhere except the contract.**

`account_id` hits 94 files. Four in `vendor/reporting-sdk` are third-party. Twelve `migrations/*.sql` are historical. Rename none of those.

[lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js) and `docs/openapi.yaml` hold the public contract field. Leave those two exactly as-is. The rest, roughly 76 files, is safe to rename.

Next: rename internal code, leave the contract alone.
